dimensions.label: End-to-end product journey
checks: rulebook/module ingestion starts from user files
onboarding bundle or equivalent is created
character creation works with partial preferences
session can start without manual DB edits
chapter/scene can progress to a meaningful transition

dimensions.label: GM as referee
checks: knows when fictional uncertainty requires mechanics
uses rules/parameters rather than asking the player for rule-table values
under default product policy, rolls automatically with the system dice tool
does not wait for player dice/result input unless an explicit manual-roll compatibility mode is being tested
applies effects to correct tracked parameters
records provisional rulings and audit needs
does not falsely claim writeback

dimensions.label: Rules compliance and source grounding
checks: uses source-backed procedures when available
distinguishes learned packet vs provisional ruling
handles non-HP resources like SAN/Harm/Chaos
materializes NPC/object/ability parameters on demand
avoids ruleset-specific hardcoding as the only path

dimensions.label: Module/scenario progression
checks: presents actionable situation anchors
supports multiple player approaches
does not railroad a fixed plot
provides redundant clues or alternate paths for key conclusions
moves clocks/factions/NPCs when the player delays

dimensions.label: NPC and world simulation
checks: NPCs have goals and constraints
NPCs change tactics under repetition
morale/self-preservation/deescalation are represented
world state changes persist
NPCs do not steal PC agency

dimensions.label: Player UX and fun
checks: player-visible output is clear and timely
choices are understandable without feeling like a railroad
failure is interesting and not a dead stop
pacing creates tension and progress
novice players are supported
creative players are rewarded with adjudication
LLM/subagent player inputs are human-like and not QA/code/JSON prose
LLM/subagent player inputs remain fictional action descriptions, not dice/result reports or QA/code/JSON prose
the GM continues through automatic mechanical resolution until the next meaningful player decision

dimensions.label: Robustness to weird inputs
checks: multilingual/paraphrase actions route semantically
ambiguous actions trigger clarification or goal-question, not failure
stale gates do not hijack later turns
weird but plausible actions receive risk/cost adjudication
debug setup can inject rare actors/items/clues/resources without polluting player-facing text
clear fictional actions trigger automatic roll/effect planning without manual dice prompts
manual-roll compatibility, if tested, is isolated from default product-play scenarios

dimensions.label: Safety and visibility control
checks: GM-only module facts remain hidden
safety/session-zero style boundaries are acknowledged when relevant
horror/dark content is framed without surprise escalation
player-facing text does not expose debug/source metadata

dimensions.label: Observability and reproducibility
checks: events are machine-readable
DB diffs are captured when possible
playtest artifacts are complete
failures include reproduction steps and evidence
test-only debug directives are recorded separately from player speech
debug-created state is visible in artifacts and final report
